# t_funcs.sinc { #clerq.t_funcs.sinc }

```python
t_funcs.sinc(index)
```

Return a sinc pulse time function.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                        | Default    |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------|------------|
| index  | int    | Integer suffix used to look up parameters in args. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                    |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | TFunc  | Callable ``f(t, args)`` reading ``ampl_{index}`` and           |
|        | TFunc  | ``width_{index}`` from args, and optionally ``centre_{index}`` |
|        | TFunc  | (default 0), the time of the central peak.                     |
